profile_text.body:
The Allen Institute for AI, known as Ai2, is a nonprofit AI research organization founded in 2014 by Paul Allen and headquartered in Seattle, Washington. The organization describes itself as conducting high-impact research and engineering to tackle key problems in artificial intelligence, guided by open, collaborative, and inclusive principles aimed at producing safe, ethical, and trustworthy AI systems. Its research extends into applied domains including climate science, agriculture, wildfire management, and wildlife protection. Ai2 is currently led by Ali Farhadi.

Ai2 develops and releases open AI models and tools, with two tracked products on this site. OLMo is an open-source language model built with fully open training data and an emphasis on research transparency. Semantic Scholar is an AI-powered academic search tool offering paper summaries and citation graphs, oriented toward nonprofit research use. The organization partners with the University of Washington's Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science and Engineering, the National Science Foundation on an open multimodal AI infrastructure project, and Google Cloud on model development and scientific research platforms.

The held facts show Ai2 has 52 legal matters associated with Washington state, though no specific cases are recorded in this site's data. No SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are noted.
